title: 皐月賞の後に・制覇と慧眼

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: T.M. is in the lead! It's T.M. Opera O! She's pulling away!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O is victorious! The spotlight's on you in this defining moment!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Do you hear it? It's the rustling of a new dawn! Life has sprung forth to honor me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Do you know what MVT stands for? It's Most Valuable T.M. Opera O! Who is that on this day?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: How right you are! I am acting in the leading role!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I am the most! I am the valuable! I am the Opera O! Me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Greetings, fans! 'Tis I!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't completely follow her, but it's clear how elated she is.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I know you're disappointed, Ayabe. However, there is no reason for regret.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Your presence was vital to making the early spring rendition of Lo, Yon Beautiful Satsuki Sho such a resounding success.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I wasn't… at my best.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh? How so?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You threw off my pace. My own weakness is to blame…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: But still, if you hadn't been around…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh… Yes, hate me! It is fitting for the rival to despise the protagonist!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But, Ayabe, was it really my fault that you weren't at your best?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Either way, if this anger fuels your improvement, I do not mind it in the least.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You don't know the first thing about me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh, but I do! I know it all! You are an Umamusume who wished to prevail in the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And the cause of your lapse in focus lies within your own mind.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Face your troubles as they arise, just as I face my reflection in the mirror each day.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, let us be off, Trainer! Haah ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning has made Opera O so happy that she laughs with glee all the way home.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: How did she… see right through me?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: She couldn't have. I don't know…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Do I need to face myself?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Tonight is a party! Everyone, dance the night away!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I'll try, Opera O! But… I'm not all that good at dancing…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I've grown tired of dancing. Come along, Trainer. We should step out.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Onto the balcony at dusk—what better stage is there for enchantment?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She brings me out onto the roof.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now that we've captured this one star, it is time to set our sights on a new goal.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What stage is worthy of my presence now that the Satsuki crown is mine?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The answer is already set. We have one crown, so it's time to take the other two.
choice_data_list: On to the Tokyo Racecourse for the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh, as I expected. Very well. I shall make the sky shine ever brighter over the supreme Classics.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ayabe will most likely… No, she will definitely run there, bringing her own flair.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Behold, Trainer… The night sky.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: That shining glimmer… It's the Derby Star!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's pointing to the North Star… which now, as I've just learned, has a new name.
